pages.text: The Ivory Crown can be made from four Bones, four Horns and a Skeleton Skull. It is designed to be primarily used alongside $(l:tools/warhorn)$(c)$(o)War & Hex Horns$(). With it, horns will have their potion effects boosted by one stage, in return lowering the effects' length from half to a third of the original. Instant effects do not gain this benefit.
The Ivory Crown offers very low defenses. However, it can still be enchanted just as any other helmet; as well as trimmed for aesthetic appeal.
